What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `xkcp`: XKCP at d20c8fc: README.markdown, lib/low/KeccakP-1600 and lib/high/Keccak (KeccakSponge, FIPS202/KeccakHash, SP800-185) state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::cshake_128`, `digests::cshake_256`, `digests::tuplehash_128`, `digests::tuplehash_256`, `digests::parallelhash_128` and `digests::parallelhash_256`: `xkcp` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).
